verdict.rationale: A public data API is a fair question for a government business-registry service, so the axis applies. The published www.sos.state.tx.us pages describe only the human-facing SOSPortal web platform: filing, searching for a $1.00 per-search fee, ordering copies, and downloadable forms. No API endpoints, key-issuance path, or rate limits are documented. Confidence is medium because the direct.sos.state.tx.us filing host was deliberately not fetched beyond robots.txt.
